lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to World 17, Starfall Observatory! Remember the star map from the old diary? It brought us here, to a white building on a hill. It's an observatory. People look at the stars here with a big telescope. Today, we're going to talk about plans. Today's sentence is: We're going to see the stars tonight. Say it with me. We're going to see the stars tonight. Great! We use going to for plans. これから する ことを いう ときに つかうよ。 I'm going to, you're going to, we're going to. Let's try. I'm going to eat dinner. We're going to sing a song. Good job! Now, phonics. Listen. Station. Vacation. Information. Observation. They all end with the same sound, shun. We spell it t, i, o, n. Station, vacation. Easy! OK, what are you going to do tonight? Let's talk!

lessons.teacherScript: Good morning, everyone! We're in the observatory cafeteria. Mmm, I smell pancakes! Today, we have a day off. So let's talk about plans for the weekend. Today's sentence is: What are you going to do this weekend? Say it with me. What are you going to do this weekend? Nice! You can answer, I'm going to clean my room. I'm going to play soccer. I'm going to read a book. しゅうまつの よていを きいて、こたえよう。 After you answer, ask back. How about you? That's a good conversation skill. Let's practice. What are you going to do this weekend? I'm going to draw pictures. How about you? Great! Now, phonics. Action. Direction. Collection. Invitation. Shun, shun, shun. Remember, t, i, o, n. OK, now ask your friends about their weekend plans!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! The star party is tonight. Let's make a plan together. In World 16, we used order words for stories. First, then, after that, finally. Today, we use them for plans. Today's sentence is: First, we're going to eat. Then, we're going to watch the stars. Say it with me. First, we're going to eat. Then, we're going to watch the stars. Excellent! After that, we're going to drink hot cocoa. Finally, we're going to go to bed. じゅんばんの ことばで けいかくを いおう。 Now, it's your turn. Tell us your plan for tonight. You can use four sentences. Then your friend can ask, What time? Asking one more question is a great skill. Now, phonics review. Nation. Rotation. Population. Celebration. All t, i, o, n. Fantastic! OK, let's present our plans!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We're in the weather room of the observatory. There are lots of screens and maps. Stargazers need good weather. If it rains, we can't see the stars! Today, we learn a new word for the future, will. Today's sentence is: Will it rain tomorrow? Say it with me. Will it rain tomorrow? Great! The answer is, I think it will. Or, I don't think so. We aren't sure about tomorrow, so we say I think. わからない ことを よそうする ときは will を つかうよ。 Let's practice. Will it be sunny tomorrow? I think it will. Will it snow tomorrow? I don't think so. Good job! Now, phonics. Television. Vision. Decision. Division. Listen to the end. Zhun. We spell it s, i, o, n. Not t, i, o, n. OK, will it rain tomorrow where you live? Let's guess!

lessons.teacherScript: Good morning, everyone! Today, we're going to be weather reporters. Riko is going to stand in front of the map. Haru has the microphone. Kiko is the camera person. Today's sentence is: It will be sunny tomorrow. Say it with me. It will be sunny tomorrow. Wonderful! It will be cloudy. It will be windy. It will be cold. You can also say, It will rain. It will snow. will の あとは うごきの ことばの もとの かたちだよ。 Rain, not rains. Let's practice. Look at the map. It will be sunny in the morning. It will rain in the afternoon. And a weather reporter often says, Don't forget your umbrella! Nice! Now, phonics. Mission. Permission. Expression. Discussion. These words have double s, then i, o, n. Shun. OK, it's your turn. Tell us tomorrow's weather!

Today's sentence is: It won't be cold. Don't worry. Say it with me. It won't be cold. Don't worry. Great! Won't means will not. It won't rain. It won't be windy. 「〜しないでしょう」は won't だよ。 You can answer a question, too. Will it be cold tonight? No, it won't. Will it be cloudy tonight? No, it won't. When a friend is worried, you can say, Don't worry. That's a kind thing to say. And it's good to bring a blanket, just in case. Now, phonics. Temperature. Picture. Nature. Adventure. The end sounds like chur, but we spell it t, u, r, e. OK, let's pack our bags for the party!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today is a big day. We're going to make a weather report show! Our show is going to be on the observatory television. Today's sentence is: Tomorrow, it will be cloudy in the morning. Say it with me. Tomorrow, it will be cloudy in the morning. Great! In the afternoon, it will be sunny. It won't rain. And at the end, say, That's all for today's weather. Have a nice day! ばんぐみの さいごの あいさつも いえると かっこいいね。 Tips for a good show. Look at the camera. Speak slowly and clearly. Use your hands to point to the map. Riko and Haru are the reporters. Kiko is going to hold the camera, and Birimo is the director. Now, phonics review. Station. Television. Mission. Future. Mixture. Tion, sion, ture. You know them all! OK, three, two, one, action! Let's start our weather show!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We're in the planetarium. The room is dark, and the stars are on the ceiling. It's beautiful! Today, we're going to learn about the moon and the Earth. Today's sentence is: The moon goes around the Earth. Say it with me. The moon goes around the Earth. Great! And the Earth goes around the sun. It takes about one year. いつも ほんとうの ことは goes や takes の かたちで いうよ。 Let's do it with our bodies. Be the sun. Be the Earth. Now, walk around the sun. Riko is the moon. She goes around the Earth. OK, let's talk about the moon and the sun!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today, we're in the space station room. There's a model of a real space station. Astronauts live there for months! How do they live? Today's sentence is: Astronauts sleep in sleeping bags. Say it with me. Astronauts sleep in sleeping bags. Great! The bags are on the wall, so they don't float away. In space, everything floats. They float in the space station. They can't take a bath. They use wet towels. うちゅうでは みずも ういて しまうんだ。 Let's pretend. Float like an astronaut. Get into your sleeping bag. Good night! Now, phonics. Will not. Won't. Won't is special. We don't say willn't. Did not. Didn't. Were not. Weren't. Could not. Couldn't. The apostrophe shows the missing o. OK, what do you want to know about life in space? Let's talk!

lessons.teacherScript: Good evening, everyone! It's Space Quiz Night at the observatory! We have two teams. Red team and blue team. Today's sentence is: Which planet is the biggest? Say it with me. Which planet is the biggest? Great! The biggest means number one in size. いちばん おおきいは the biggest だよ。 To answer, say, I think it's Jupiter. If it's correct, the quiz master says, That's right! If not, Good try! The answer is Mars. Let's make our own quiz questions, too. Which planet is red? Which planet has rings? What goes around the Earth? Great questions! Listen carefully, and don't shout the answer. Wait for your turn. Now, phonics review. I'll. Won't. She'll. Rotation. Vision. You remember them all! OK, are you ready? Raise your hand and answer! Good luck, everyone!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Look at these photos on the wall. They're astronauts. They are floating and smiling. Do you want to go to space someday? Today's sentence is: Someday I will go to space. Say it with me. Someday I will go to space. Wonderful! Someday means one day in the future. いつかの ゆめは Someday I will ～. で いえるよ。 I will be an astronaut. I will see the Earth from space. Your dream doesn't have to be about space. Someday I will be a baker. Someday I will swim in the sea. Let's practice. Someday I will travel. Great! Now, phonics. See and sea. They sound the same, but the meanings are different. You see with your eyes. Sea is the ocean. Meet and meat. Nice to meet you. I like meat. OK, what's your dream?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today, let's use our imagination. Close your eyes. It's twenty years from now. You're a grown-up! What are you doing? Today's sentence is: What will you be in twenty years? Say it with me. What will you be in twenty years? Great! You can answer, I'll be a doctor. I'll be a chef. Not sure? Then you can say, I think I'll be a teacher. Add a reason. I like helping people. I like cooking. りゆうを ひとこと いうと、もっと つたわるね。 Let's practice. What will you be in twenty years? I think I'll be a pilot. I like airplanes. Great! Now, phonics. Sun and son. One and won. The sun is hot. He is her son. I have one cat. We won the game! Same sounds, different spellings. OK, what will you be?

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We're in the Future Life room. Look! There's a robot folding laundry, and a model of a flying car. What will life be like in the future? Today's sentence is: I think robots will help us at home. Say it with me. I think robots will help us at home. Excellent! I think cars will fly in the sky. I think we will live on the moon. Your friend may say, I don't think so. That's OK. Ask, Really? Why? いけんが ちがっても だいじょうぶ。りゆうを きいてみよう。 Let's practice. I think robots will cook dinner. I don't think so. Really? Why? Robots can't taste food! Ha ha! Now, phonics. Two, to, too. I have two eyes. Let's go to the moon. I like it, too. Blue and blew. The sky is blue. The wind blew. OK, what will the future be like? Tell us your idea!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Imagine you have a space rocket. You can go anywhere! Where do you want to go? And why? Today's sentence is: I want to go to Mars because it's exciting. Say it with me. I want to go to Mars because it's exciting. Great! Because tells the reason. I want to go to the moon because it's close. I want to go to Saturn because the rings are pretty. りゆうは because の あとに いうよ。 Your friend can ask, Why? Then you say, Because I like red. Let's practice. Where do you want to go? I want to go to Jupiter. Why? Because it's very big! Great job! Now, phonics. There and their. Look over there! It's their telescope. Here and hear. Come here. I can hear music. OK, where do you want to go, and why?

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! The observatory is going to send a message into space. Maybe someone far away will read it! What do we want to say about Earth? Today's sentence is: Hello! We live on Earth. We like music. Say it with me. Hello! We live on Earth. We like music. Great! Tell them about our planet. We have oceans, forests, and many animals. We like soccer. We eat rice and bread. And at the end, Please write back to us! Here's an important rule. You don't need to write your real name or address. ほんとうの なまえや じゅうしょは かかなくて いいよ。 You can sign it, From the children of Earth. Now, phonics. Roar. Board. Aboard. Keyboard. The or sound here is o, a, r. Lions roar. All aboard! OK, let's write our message to space!

I'm going to go hiking. How about you? Great! After you share your plan, ask, How about you? If your friend has the same idea, say, Why don't we go together? That means, let's go together. いっしょに しようと さそう いいかただよ。 Your friend can say, Great idea! We'll have fun. If your friend is busy, it's OK. Just say, Maybe next time! Let's practice. lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today, we're going to write a note to ourselves. Not for today, for the future! We'll put the notes in the observatory time capsule. Today's sentence is: Dear future me, I will keep studying English. Say it with me. Dear future me, I will keep studying English. Wonderful! Write three or four sentences. I will practice the piano. I hope you are happy. Are you still drawing pictures? みらいの じぶんに しつもんを しても いいよ。 And remember, you don't need to write your real name or address. You can sign it, From me. Read your note to a friend. Your friend can say, That's a nice note! Maybe you'll open the time capsule when you're grown up. Now, phonics review. Future. Adventure. Explore. Before. OK, take out your pencils, and let's write to future you!

lessons.teacherScript: Good evening, everyone! This is our last night at the observatory. Let's have a goodbye stargazing party and look back at World 17. Today's sentence is: Will it be clear tonight? I think it will. Say it with me. Will it be clear tonight? I think it will. Great! Let's remember. Going to is for plans. I'm going to visit my grandma. Will is for guesses. It will rain. Will is also for offers and promises. I'll help you. I'll call you. よてい、よそう、もうしで、やくそく。ぜんぶ いえるね。 And you can say, I'll miss the observatory. That means you will feel sad because you're leaving. We had so many good times here. Thank you, observatory! Now, phonics review. Station. It'll. See. North. Four. OK, let's look at the stars one more time!

segments.say: Show. Lights, music, and everyone watching. Show!
segments.subtitleJa: show。ライト、おんがく、みんなが みている。show！
segments.subtitleEn: Show. Lights, music, and everyone watching. Show!

segments.say: Dome. A big round roof, like half a ball. Look up! Dome!
segments.subtitleJa: dome。ボールを はんぶんに した ような、おおきな まるい やね。うえを みて！ dome！
segments.subtitleEn: Dome. A big round roof, like half a ball. Look up! Dome!

segments.say: Travel. Pack your bag and go far, far away. Travel!
segments.subtitleJa: travel。かばんに にもつを つめて、とおく とおくへ。travel！
segments.subtitleEn: Travel. Pack your bag and go far, far away. Travel!

segments.say: Valley. Low, green land between two mountains. valley は たに. Valley!
segments.subtitleJa: valley。ふたつの やまの あいだの、ひくくて みどりの ばしょ。valley は「たに」。valley！
segments.subtitleEn: Valley. Low, green land between two mountains. Valley!

segments.say: Listen. Riko says, Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky. Haru says, This is the Sleepy Bear. Long ago, a little bear climbed up to the sky. Kiko says, And this is our constellation, the Happy Cat!
segments.subtitleJa: きいてね。リコちゃん「こんや、よぞらを おみせ します。」 ハルくん「これが ねむい くま。むかし、こぐまが そらへ のぼったんだ。」 キコちゃん「そして これが わたしたちの せいざ、しあわせ ねこ！」
segments.subtitleEn: Listen. Riko says, Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky. Haru says, This is the Sleepy Bear. Long ago, a little bear climbed up to the sky. Kiko says, And this is our constellation, the Happy Cat!

slide.title: Talk
items: Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky.
This is the Sleepy Bear. Long ago, a little bear climbed up to the sky.
And this is our constellation, the Happy Cat!

segments.say: Birimo shouts, Someday we will travel to the stars! I say, Bravo! Now, look through the telescope. There's a green valley between the mountains. Haru calls, Hello! Hello! Oh, my voice came back!
segments.subtitleJa: ビリモ「いつか ぼくたちは ほしへ たびを するんだ！」 わたし「ブラボー！ さあ、ぼうえんきょうを のぞいて。やまの あいだに みどりの たにが あるわ。」 ハルくん「ハロー！ ハロー！ あ、こえが かえってきた！」
segments.subtitleEn: Birimo shouts, Someday we will travel to the stars! I say, Bravo! Now, look through the telescope. There's a green valley between the mountains. Haru calls, Hello! Hello! Oh, my voice came back!

slide.title: Talk
items: Someday we will travel to the stars!
Bravo! Now, look through the telescope. There's a green valley between the mountains.
Hello! Hello! Oh, my voice came back. Is that our next stop?

segments.say: Here's the point. Going to for plans. Will for dreams and guesses. I'll for offers and promises. ゆめは will. And add because for your reason!
segments.subtitleJa: ポイント。けいかくは going to。ゆめや よそうは will。もうしでや やくそくは I'll。ゆめは will。りゆうは because で つけよう！
segments.subtitleEn: Here's the point. Going to for plans. Will for dreams and guesses. I'll for offers and promises. And add because for your reason!

segments.say: World 17 sound review! Constellation. Mission. Future. We'll. There. Roar. Shun, shun, chur. We'll is we will. There sounds like their. And roar says or!
segments.subtitleJa: ワールド17 の おとの ふりかえり！ constellation、mission、future、we'll、there、roar。ション、ション、チャー。we'll は we will。there は their と おなじ おと。そして roar は「オー」！
segments.subtitleEn: World 17 sound review! Constellation. Mission. Future. We'll. There. Roar. Shun, shun, chur. We'll is we will. There sounds like their. And roar says or!

segments.say: Your turn. Constellation. Mission. Future. We'll. There. Roar. The rocket goes roar!
segments.subtitleJa: あなたの ばん。constellation、mission、future、we'll、there、roar。ロケットが ゴーッ！
segments.subtitleEn: Your turn. Constellation. Mission. Future. We'll. There. Roar. The rocket goes roar!

segments.say: Let's move! Remember World 1? Look! Stop! Come here! Go! Now World 17. Blast off! Float! Make a wish!
segments.subtitleJa: からだを うごかそう！ ワールド1 を おぼえてる？ みて！ とまって！ きて！ いって！ つぎは ワールド17。はっしゃ！ ういて！ ねがって！
segments.subtitleEn: Let's move! Remember World 1? Look! Stop! Come here! Go! Now World 17. Blast off! Float! Make a wish!

slide.title: Let's move!
items: Blast off! Float! Make a wish!

segments.say: Stand under the dome. Look up, chest out! Now, take a bow. Slowly. The crowd is cheering!
segments.subtitleJa: ドームの したに たって。うえを みて、むねを はって！ つぎは おじぎを して。ゆっくり。はくしゅ かっさい！
segments.subtitleEn: Stand under the dome. Look up, chest out! Now, take a bow. Slowly. The crowd is cheering!

segments.say: Repeat after me. Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky.
segments.subtitleJa: まねして いってね。「こんや、よぞらを おみせ します。」
segments.subtitleEn: Repeat after me. Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky.

slide.title: Say it!
items: Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky.

segments.say: Someday we will travel to the stars!
segments.subtitleJa: 「いつか わたしたちは ほしへ たびを します！」
segments.subtitleEn: Someday we will travel to the stars!

slide.title: Say it!
items: Someday we will travel to the stars!

segments.say: I think it will be a wonderful show. Have fun!
segments.subtitleJa: 「すばらしい ショーに なると おもいます。たのしんで ください！」
segments.subtitleEn: I think it will be a wonderful show. Have fun!

slide.title: Say it!
items: I think it will be a wonderful show. Have fun!

segments.say: Your turn! Tell us your dream. Someday I will... because... Any dream is wonderful!
segments.subtitleJa: あなたの ばん！ ゆめを おしえて。Someday I will… because…。どんな ゆめでも すてき！
segments.subtitleEn: Your turn! Tell us your dream. Someday I will... because... Any dream is wonderful!

segments.say: Final quiz! The show plan is ready. A, Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky. Or B, Tonight, we going show you the night sky. Think!
segments.subtitleJa: さいごの クイズ！ ショーの けいかくは できているよ。A「Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky.」 B「Tonight, we going show you the night sky.」 かんがえて！
segments.subtitleEn: Final quiz! The show plan is ready. A, Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky. Or B, Tonight, we going show you the night sky. Think!

segments.say: It's A! We're going to. Don't forget are and to. You're a World 17 superstar!
segments.subtitleJa: こたえは A！ We're going to。are と to を わすれずに。あなたは ワールド17 の スーパースター！
segments.subtitleEn: It's A! We're going to. Don't forget are and to. You're a World 17 superstar!

slide.title: Answer
items: Tonight, we're going to show you the night sky.

segments.say: Bravo! You can share plans, dreams, guesses, and promises. Next, talk with Birimo! ビリモ と おはなし してね. Next is World 18, Echo Valley! See you there!
segments.subtitleJa: ブラボー！ けいかく、ゆめ、よそう、やくそくが いえるね。このあと ビリモと おはなし してね。つぎは ワールド18、こだまの たに！ そこで あおうね！
segments.subtitleEn: Bravo! You can share plans, dreams, guesses, and promises. Next, talk with Birimo! Next is World 18, Echo Valley! See you there!
